literal_meaning: বসে থাকা বা স্থাপন করা (to sit or to be placed)
figurative_meaning_en: to fit perfectly; to be suitable or appropriate
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই শার্টটা তার উপর খুব সুন্দর বসে।
example_sentences_in_english: The window fits perfectly in the wall.
note: This idiom is commonly used in contexts involving physical fitting of objects or suitability in everyday Bengali speech.
